lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical high-contrast lines; spacing is irregularly distributed, with tighter clustering toward the mid-torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 5th vertical line from the anterior, splitting toward the lower flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 4, 6, 8, and 11 exhibit significant discontinuities, manifesting as discrete elliptical blobs rather than continuous vertical strokes.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5 distinct white spots is located on the posterior flank and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-haunch align horizontally to form a semi-continuous geometric line segment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a lyrate trajectory, curving outward from the base before angling inward and upward toward the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 1.5 times the width of the inter-horn distance at the base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-toned tipping comprises approximately the terminal 12-15% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white facial chevron between the eyes and a shaggy, dark ventral fringe extending from the lower neck to the belly.
